Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the sample bundle. Short answer: portal first, envelope by email is supported with a small set of constraints. Details and a minimal CSV example below so your engineering team can map it.

Portal vs email envelope (our recommendation):
- Portal (preferred): idempotency, status tracking (ACK/NAK), and automatic PO-match. If your SSO or SFTP pairing is possible for EMEA, that will give the best recovery and traceability.
- Email envelope (acceptable fallback): accepted to our vendor inbox but requires a standardized manifest CSV and a unique invoice_id per invoice for idempotency. We provide an acknowledgement token in the subject and in the response body once processed.

Envelope rules (email fallback):
- Manifest: UTF-8 CSV, comma-separated, header row required.
- Required header columns: invoice_id, po_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount, currency, tax_amount, vat_number, attachment_filename
- Optional columns: gl_account, line_description, line_amount
- Each attachment_filename must exactly match a file inside the zip.
- Multiple PO numbers per invoice: supported only if PO numbers are pipe-separated in the po_number field (e.g., PO123|PO124). We strongly recommend one PO per invoice for simpler matching.
- Max envelope size via SMTP: 25MB. For larger batches, use our SFTP endpoint or portal upload (we'll share credentials).
- Idempotency: supply a stable invoice_id (your ERP invoice UID). If we receive the same invoice_id twice, we ignore duplicates and reply with the original ACK.

Minimal CSV sample (first two lines):
invoice_id,po_number,invoice_date,amount,currency,tax_amount,vat_number,attachment_filename,gl_account
SL-INV-2026-001,PO-99321,2026-07-01,1245.00,USD,124.50,GB123456789,INV_2026_001.pdf,4300
SL-INV-2026-002,PO-99322,2026-07-02,650.00,USD,65.00,GB123456789,INV_2026_002.pdf,4300

Attachments I've included for reference: sample_csv_map.csv (header + example rows), envelope_spec.pdf (processing rules).

Next steps: if that layout works, please send a small test envelope (2-3 invoices) to vendors-inbox@redwood.ai and mention "ack: test-<your-corp>-YYYYMMDD" in the subject so we can correlate. I'll loop in Vanessa to confirm SLA and exception routing.

Best,

Hi Sara — looping in final guidance from AP/Onboarding.

On Sat, Jul 18, 2026 at 10:05 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [quoted excerpt]
> Minimal CSV sample (first two lines):
> invoice_id,po_number,invoice_date,amount,currency,tax_amount,vat_number,attachment_filename,gl_account
> SL-INV-2026-001,PO-99321,2026-07-01,1245.00,USD,124.50,GB123456789,INV_2026_001.pdf,4300

Answers:
- GL account: optional. If absent we map to the vendor default GL and flag the invoice for reconciliation in AP. It will not be rejected automatically.
- Missing PO: if no PO is present we route the invoice to AP exception handling and create a ticket. That will delay posting until the PO is provided or AP approves a non-PO invoice. Please include a contact on the CSV manifest (contact_name and contact_email columns are acceptable additions) so we can resolve quickly.
- Vendor inbox and subject convention: send to vendors-inbox@redwood.ai. Use subject: "Envelope: <company>-<date> ack: <your-token>". Example: "Envelope: Starlite-20260719 ack: ST-TEST-0001". The ack token can be any alpha-numeric string; we'll return the same token in our ACK message.
- Envelope size and frequency: 25MB max per email. For daily large volumes, recommend SFTP and we'll provision a job to pull.

I'll add PROC-451 to track your onboarding and attach the playbook link for file layout and exception SLAs. We'll monitor the first test and drop you a ticket if AP needs more context.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
